title: Plan, apply and destroy with CLI options
intro: A small network is deployed from `/home/coder/lab` with the default variable values (`environment = "dev"`). The configuration is initialized and applied. Open a terminal via **☰ → Terminal → New Terminal**.

tasks.text: Save a plan for production to the file `tfplan` in the lab folder. It must use the values from `prod.tfvars`.
Apply exactly the saved plan `tfplan`, so the VPC and subnet carry `Environment = prod`.
The subnet is broken. Recreate **only** the subnet, without editing any file. The VPC must keep its ID.
The security group `debug` is no longer needed. Destroy only this security group, then remove it from the configuration.
Protect the VPC so that any plan that would destroy it fails.
Finish clean: `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` reports no changes.
